au-f2006l01785.summary: ADR 11/00 sets requirements for internal sun visors to reduce injury potential to occupants from the visor and adjacent vehicle structure. It requires no sharp rigid mounting edges, energy-absorbing covering and padded mirror edges, and an energy-absorption head-impact test. It applies to passenger cars, light omnibuses and light goods vehicles (and enclosed motor tricycles) from dates in the applicability table.
au-f2006l01785._why: Function clause 2.2 (reduce injury potential); clauses 11.2-11.3; applicability table shows M1, M2 up to 5t, N1, N2 up to 4.5t, LE only; 11.4 alternative standards removed

au-f2006l02294.summary: ADR 46/00 prescribes the photometric requirements for vehicle headlamps so they give adequate illumination for the driver without undue glare to other road users. Compliance is by Appendices A-G (UN Regulations 1, 5, 8, 20, 31, 112 and 113 texts, with exemptions) or by listed alternative standards, including SAE J579c and JIS D5500. Whether headlamps are required is set by ADRs 13, 19 and 67.
au-f2006l02294._why: Scope clause 2, requirements 4.1, alternative standards list in part 7

au-f2006l02296.summary: ADR 50/00 prescribes the photometric requirements for front fog lamps. Whether such lamps are mandatory, optional or prohibited is set by ADRs 13, 19 and 67. Compliance is by the technical requirements of Appendix A (UN Regulation No. 19, with listed exemptions and substitutions) or by UN Regulation No. 19 as an alternative standard (01 to 04 series of amendments).
au-f2006l02296._why: Clause 1 scope; 4.1; 7.1 alternative standard UN R19 incl. 01-04 series

au-f2006l02297._why: Purpose/scope and clauses 65.2-65.6: speed limited by gearing or governor, max speed capability, test; applies to M3 over 5t and N3 (table)

au-f2006l02298.summary: ADR 64/00 specifies additional design and construction requirements for heavy goods vehicles (category NC, N3) designed to haul road trains and B-doubles. It requires a trailer lighting supply of 30 A at 12 V or 15 A at 24 V, a single trailer connector, resettable circuit breakers and a minimum generator output, plus a minimum air delivery for the braking system and antilock systems on all axle groups of B-doubles.
au-f2006l02298._why: Function clause B; applicability table (only NC from 1 July 1991); 64.4 electrical, 64.5 braking incl. ABS; no EMC content

au-f2006l02299._why: Function clause B.1 trailers for road trains (GCM up to 125 t), 63.4 electrical, 63.5 mechanical coupling; applies to O3/O4; no braking requirements in text

au-f2006l02300._why: Function clause: supplementary centre high-mounted stop lamp; table covers M1 categories only

au-f2006l02301.summary: ADR 57/00 specifies special construction requirements for L-group vehicles (mopeds, motorcycles and sidecar combinations), additional to other ADRs. It covers side-cars, handlebar and steering gear dimensions, location and operation of controls, visual indicator display and identification, and chain guards. ECE R60 (motorcycle/moped controls) is deemed equivalent for the controls requirements.
au-f2006l02301._why: Scope B, clauses 57.2.1-57.2.3 (side-cars, steering gear and handlebars, controls), 57.3 deems ECE R60 equivalent; applies LA, LC, LD

au-f2006l02302.summary: ADR 55/00 prescribes the photometric requirements for headlamps provided for motorcycles and other L-group vehicles treated as such. Compliance is by Appendix A (UN Regulation No. 57 text, with listed exemptions) or by alternative standards: UN Regulations 57 and 72, JIS D5500 Grade C1 and SAE J584. Whether headlamps are required is set by ADRs 19 and 67.

au-f2006l02303.summary: ADR 53/00 prescribes the photometric requirements for front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, direction indicators and rear registration plate illuminating devices fitted to mopeds, motorcycles and vehicles treated as such. Compliance is by Appendix A (UN Regulation No. 50 text, with listed exemptions) or by any edition of UN Regulation No. 50. Fitment is set by ADRs 19 and 67.
au-f2006l02303._why: Scope clause 2; 4.1; alternative standard 7.1 UN R50

au-f2006l02304._why: Scope: photometric requirements for rear fog lamps; alt standard UN R38

au-f2006l02305._why: Scope: gas discharge headlamps; alt standard UN R98

au-f2006l02306._why: Scope: daytime running lamps, alt standard UN R87

au-f2006l02307.summary: ADR 75/00 prescribes requirements for the installation and testing of headlamp cleaners fitted to motor vehicles. Whether headlamp cleaners are mandatory, optional or prohibited is set by ADRs 13, 19 and 67. Compliance is by Appendix A (UN Regulation No. 45/01 text, with exemptions) or by UN Regulation No. 45, including the 01 series of amendments.
au-f2006l02307._why: Scope clause 2; 4.1; alternative standard 7.1 UN R45

au-f2006l02308._why: Function: photometric requirements of side marker lamps; alt standard UN R91 deemed equivalent

au-f2006l02310.summary: ADR 67/00 ensures that the installation of lighting and light-signalling devices on three-wheeled vehicles does not impair their effective operation. It sets the required, optional and prohibited lamps, their colours and positions, and applies to 3-wheeled mopeds (LB) and motor tricycles (LE) manufactured on or after 1 July 1992. Vehicles certified to ADR 19 need not comply.
au-f2006l02310._why: Function clause 2.1; applicability table (LB, LE from 1 July 1992); clause 3.3 ADR 19 exemption

au-f2006l02312._why: Function and scope A; B.2 exclusions; alt standard ECE R80 deemed equivalent; applies M2 over 3.5t and M3

au-f2006l02729._why: Scope: headlamps for mopeds with single passing beam; alt standards UN R56 and R76

au-f2006l02732._why: Scope: gas-discharge light sources; alt standard UN R99
